notes:
- **Audio info** follows the playback clock, with more contrast between frequency bands and even gaps between bars.
- The **Play** button in **Genres** fades in and out when you move the pointer onto or off the artwork.
- **Up Next** uses the same miniature spectrum indicator as **Songs** and removes stray pixels beside its list headers.
- Compact cover thumbnails share an 88 px cache. **Songs** uses a separate 44 px thumbnail size.
- In **Lyrics**, untimed text starts scrolling at the same height as the active line of timed lyrics.

Requires macOS 27 or later on Apple silicon. The app archive is ad-hoc signed.
